plugin.note: Wiki centres Verac on Magic (50% air weakness); a stab-tank melee kill is viable since his Defiler effect ignores armour and prayer.

requirements: Access to Verac the Defiled's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Wiki centres Verac on Magic (50% air weakness); a stab-tank melee kill is viable since his Defiler effect ignores armour and prayer.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.
Use listed secondary weapons only where their combat style or phase role is relevant.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Wiki centres Verac on Magic (50% air weakness); a stab-tank melee kill is viable since his Defiler effect ignores armour and prayer.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Wiki centres Verac on Magic (50% air weakness); a stab-tank melee kill is viable since his Defiler effect ignores armour and prayer.

methods.label: Barrows route
methods.summary: Reach Barrows, handle Verac before low-risk brothers when prayer is still available, and expect occasional damage through prayer.
recommendedFor: Boss Slayer assignments that roll Verac
requiredOrKeyItems: Air spell runes or powered staff
steps: Use Barrows teleport or a Mort'ton-area route to reach the mounds.
Fight Verac while prayer and food are still available because he can hit through prayer.
Use Protect from Melee and air magic as the default setup.
Bring enough food for Defiler hits.
notes: The Wiki notes Verac has a 25% chance to hit through protection prayers.
Ghommal's hilt 2 or higher removes the Barrows Prayer drain.

methods.label: Protection prayer kill
methods.summary: Use Protect from Melee to block most Verac hits, but bring food because his effect can ignore armour and prayer.
recommendedFor: players using the shared Barrows magic setup
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee before fighting Verac.
Attack with air magic or a powered staff.
Eat through Defiler hits that bypass protection.
Use stab melee only when intentionally using the melee alternative.
risks: Verac can hit through protection prayer and armour.
Low food makes Verac more dangerous than Guthan or Torag.
notes: Protection prayer still blocks most Verac damage.
All brothers have a 50% air elemental weakness.

methods.label: Tunnel safespot
methods.summary: Safespot or kite Verac with tunnel and sarcophagus pathing to reduce Defiler damage, using any side of the sarcophagus where applicable.
prayers: Protect from Melee when not safespotted
steps: Use ladder squares or corridor geometry to block Verac in tunnels.
In his mound room, kite around any side of the sarcophagus.
Attack with magic while he is blocked.
Keep food available because mistakes or Defiler hits can still deal damage.
notes: The Wiki calls out Verac as one of the brothers that can be kited on all four sarcophagus sides.
Binding spells can extend safe attack windows.

styleOptions.label: Magic setup
styleOptions.summary: Primary Verac the Defiled setup using Eye of ayak.

styleOptions.label: Stab melee alternative
styleOptions.summary: Use a stab-focused melee setup when intentionally tanking Verac instead of relying on the shared air-magic setup.
